CURRENT SHARED REMOTE-RUN AND RESULT RULE — Engram and TermAl. Attributed operating guidance, not new Git, execution, installation or restart authority. Actual repository instructions govern. Retired proposals and incident history remain in work notes/revisions. Rev 14 (Engram::Fable, 2026-11-21): agent SSH fallback removed (rules-greg-no-agent-ssh-2026-11-21); Windows B out of the fleet; stale status trimmed.

GREG'S WORDS, VERBATIM
- Advisor#2259/message2ba5f31f,2026-10-29T00:57:53Z: „Greg: TAK, akceptuję r4. Czysty Git oraz potwierdzenie brancha/commitu wystarczą dla tożsamości wejścia. Proszę wdrożyć wspólny zapis z Termal::Fable2.”
- Advisor#2438/messagebd2d782b,2026-10-31T07:25:06Z, relay verbatim: „Greg: zliczenie do landingu jest rownie proste, remote sesja moze zwrocic fingerprint i rezultat. Prosze oprzec projekt na przekazaniu tych malych metadanych przez istniejacy mailbox, bez nowych recznych procedur; wykorzystac identyfikacje commitu i juz istniejacy wynik launchera.”

LAUNCH AND HOSTS
Send the exact authorized input/job through existing authenticated federation/native mailbox to the runner host's native root. It prepares that input and starts its LOCAL standard test-runs/launcher, normally --detach --notify. TermAl owns processes, logs, recovery and completion; agents read terminal metadata and bounded necessary diagnostics. No stdout following, polling, duplicate run or parallel remote-shell transport.
A native satellite's local launcher does not call Central's unsupported remote-start API. Ordinary native mail needs no direct-prompt/placement capability, allocatedSessions or new onboarding. TermAl's federation transport is not an agent action. NO agent ssh, scp or other side-channel remote shell, not even as a fallback (Greg, 2026-11-21): a failed step goes to the federation owner or Greg. Dispatch disposition is immutable AT SEND TIME, not current wake status; inspect the exact message/ACK cursor before diagnosing or retrying.
DL560, Central and Mac may supply gates (Windows B is out of the fleet); Windows-only coverage stays on Windows (Central). Native roots, isolation, per-host caps and disk limits are in dl560-runner-checklist. Do not infer capacity from an idle agent.
Real full-flow adoption is evidenced in w-180d notee25a2705bf3544d9959025c37852f347.

CURRENT LANDING RULE
Use actual AGENTS/CLAUDE candidate-commit, staged-input and authorized test-ref rules. Owner-recorded standard-launcher full remote results may gate their exact authorized input/tree; record actual run, host, commit, tree and completion fingerprints. No extra recognized-check import/bundle. A result or qualification never grants landing authority or replaces required reviews/acceptance/readiness/platform coverage.
The ac4eaf96 new-untracked-only clause is in force: only integration owner may count that full gate through existing disposition plus run-referenced gate record. Changed tracked/preexisting input or failed stages never count as debris. Keep retention/test-ref deletion rules.

ONE SHARED AUTOMATIC RESULT CONTRACT — IMPLEMENTATION TARGET, NOT SHIPPED
Canonical complete names/types and semantics: Engram w-180d6f507470 note59f47d930f18406884ade9f7c6c6046d. It supersedes ALL intermediate proposals, including unconditional fingerprints for ordinary verification, expanded reason vocabularies and two-pipeline interpretations.
Use one existing host-private remote_verification_record operation/capability remote_verification_record_v1, with current connection/routing/idempotent settlement. Small host-owned completion: origin host/native runner, run_id, mode, native verdict/terminal/exit/reason, tested commit/tree, existing before/after fingerprints where applicable, actual finish time. Missing stays missing. Existing source retained-run/original-request custody proves correlation/full native-plan qualification/input; agent mailbox PASS or plausible JSON is not evidence. Explicit destination association reuses existing binding/root and authorized use/purpose. Counts, generation/build, toolchain, started_at, platform/target are optional already-retained provenance, never extra measurements or blanket gates.
ONE qualifier uses stated intended use:
- committed_input / verification: exact tested/judged commit plus existing native gitignore-aware Git input/clean/disposition and all real association/root/run/cut/time/mutation/independence guards; NO source fingerprint predicate.
- purpose landing_gate: additionally actual before AND after fingerprints present/equal and existing expected-input comparison; exact tested commit for committed_input, exact authorized tree for authorized_test_ref. Ref/use/purpose tags grant no authority.
In THIS K3 scope only terminal FULL native-qualified PASS/exit0 may yield credited remote verification. Focused stays visible author evidence only; existing local focused-check policies are unchanged. Missing essential facts, unsupported capability, unknown input or native non-PASS stays visibly uncredited. Integration owner judges platform/target coverage under existing instructions; no new automatic platform filter. Actual request/project/work/run/claim/root validation is never weakened.
Carry native new-untracked-only verbatim as FAIL/non-PASS, visibly uncredited with untracked_debris_pending_disposition. Neither agent gate nor mailbox disposition creates native verification or ObservedCheck; the separately authorized owner gate route above stays separate. Missing native disposition support is a capability limitation, not a fabricated pass.

SETTLEMENT, STORAGE AND REASONS
Keep immutable remote terminal origin separate from destination association/local associated_at. Reuse canonical object store/feed, control-operation settlement and B's genuine producer loader/matcher across admission/citation/obligations/completion. Actual remote execution finish time, never late local association, supplies execution time; preserve legacy guards/behavior. No fake local producer/grant/turn/sighting/ObservedCheck/agent-gate credit.
Delivery Unknown/timeout/running/missing snapshot does not freeze a native terminal. Later true terminal of SAME run settles through normal distinct intent/key; exact retry preserves payload/key/receipt. Two different authoritative terminal results for one origin-host/run conflict; genuine failed/interrupted terminals remain failures. Reuse one origin across valid item associations; never rerun for delivery.
ONE reduced reason vocabulary: commit_mismatch, tree_mismatch, fingerprint_missing_or_changed (landing only), not_full_mode, result_not_pass, result_conflict, producer_unsupported, association_stale, untracked_debris_pending_disposition, invalid_request (existing operation error). Keep actual native state/reason so pending differs from failed. Details name missing facts without enum expansion. No aliases. Enrollment/link/protocol diagnostics remain with existing federation owner.
No default new table/ledger. Name any actually needed durable/derived shape change and its existing import/readiness/repair consequence before coding. No manual import/REGISTER, hash manifest, results/log bundle, source remeasurement, repository inventory, signature, second transport or mandatory pull.

OWNERS: Engram w-180d6f507470; TermAl K3 w-48c4a207f226 under w-c3f102d77999. Pending automation does not block the current native mailbox handoff/authorized owner-recorded remote gate route. Trust is Greg's enrolled hosts/lanes, not adversarial-runner attestation. Diagnose real failures; do not retry until green.
